_comment: name -> Hugging Face dataset. EVERY entry is verified:false: these ids/configs were written from documentation and could not be checked against the live hub from the build sandbox (it has no access to huggingface.co). `chat fetch NAME` prints the real HTTP error if one is wrong; fix it with your own catalog file (config key fetch.catalog).

pippa.note: Unfiltered user-submitted roleplay. The safety filter drops sexual content and anything sexual involving minors or family members; set filter.persona.enabled in the folder's dataset.json to keep only sister/sibling personas.

stack_v2.note: Metadata only: the file contents live in Software Heritage's S3 bucket, so this cannot be turned into training text through the rows API. Drop local .py files into data/code/ instead.

feedback_collection.note: Listed in some sources as kaist-ai/Feedback-Collection.

shepherd.note: This repository id came from a third-party list and may not exist; if fetch reports 404, supply the correct id with --repo.

toolbench.note: May not exist as a rows-API dataset; ToolBench is usually distributed as a Google-Drive archive. Download it by hand into data/tools/.

bfcl.note: An evaluation set (questions + function schemas, no gold chats in every config): use dataset.json mapping if you want to train on it.

lj_speech.note: Audio: download the clips + metadata.csv from the dataset page into data/audio/ and run `voice train-stt`.

vctk.note: Audio: download manually into data/audio/ (see docs/VOICE.md).

common_voice.note: Audio and gated: accept the licence on the hub, download a language pack by hand into data/audio/.
